snippet.title: RED KITE - A #metroidvania #platformer
snippet.description:
RED KITE is a Metroidvania platformer releasing on June 20, 2026.

Join RED KITE on his thrilling adventure and in his fight against the corporate giant NeoTerra, which controls the world's politics, justice system, and culture through its corrupt system.
